title: WindServe: Efficient Phase-Disaggregated LLM Serving with Stream-based Dynamic Scheduling
problem: Phase-disaggregated LLM serving systems that separate compute-bound prefill from memory-bandwidth-bound decoding still suffer from coarse-grained static scheduling that leaves prefill compute overloaded while decoding resources sit idle, creating queuing delays and underutilization. KV cache transfers between disaggregated phases introduce additional scheduling overhead that further degrades latency SLOs.
motivation: LLM inference serving must meet tight TTFT (time-to-first-token) and TPOT (time-per-output-token) SLOs under high load, but existing disaggregated systems use static assignment that cannot adapt to dynamic request arrival patterns and resource availability.
method: WindServe uses a central scheduler that constantly watches how much compute and memory each part of the system is using, then dynamically reassigns jobs between the compute-heavy prefill phase (which prepares input) and the memory-heavy decoding phase (which generates output) to avoid queuing and reduce overhead from moving KV caches (data that stores the model's context) between phases. Its stall-free rescheduling strategy keeps memory constantly busy during these data transfers without creating scheduling pauses. A stream-based pipeline separates prefill and decoding tasks into different execution channels and handles their dependencies asynchronously, preventing interference when both run at the same time.
key_novelty: WindServe's key breakthrough is a rescheduling method that keeps memory constantly busy while moving KV caches between phases without scheduling delays, enabling dynamic load balancing that static schedules cannot match.
contributions: Fine-grained dynamic scheduler monitoring compute and memory resource utilization to orchestrate cross-phase job assignment in real time.
Stall-free rescheduling strategy that saturates memory resources while KV cache transfers occur between prefill and decoding nodes.
Stream-based pipeline that mitigates interference between co-running prefill and decoding jobs.
4.28x improvement in TTFT median latency and 1.5x reduction in TPOT P99 latency over state-of-the-art phase-disaggregated serving systems.
